+  @doc "The cached map of built-in name → `Jsonata.Function`."
+  @spec builtins() :: %{optional(String.t()) => Function.t()}
+  def builtins do
+    case :persistent_term.get({__MODULE__, :builtins}, nil) do
+      nil ->
+        map = build_builtins()
+        :persistent_term.put({__MODULE__, :builtins}, map)
+        map
+
+      map ->
+        map
+    end
+  end
